theorem alphaZ_folded_residue (b m n l j : ℕ) (hb : 2 < b)
    (hf : n = 2 * l * m + j ∨ (n = 2 * l * m - j ∧ 0 < j ∧ j < 2 * l * m)) :
    (alphaZ b (m + 1) - alphaZ b (m - 1)) ∣ alphaZ b n - alphaZ b j ∨
      (alphaZ b (m + 1) - alphaZ b (m - 1)) ∣ alphaZ b n + alphaZ b j := by
